verdict.rationale: Poke's release notes say it can create tables and charts from descriptions or spreadsheet images, and can create and deploy websites at yourname.poke.com. Both are generated artifacts, but neither is a document, presentation, or exportable file. Missing for 10: document creation (e.g., docs or word-processing files), presentation/slide creation, iterative editing of created files, file export or download formats, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
